title: I personally did not like this lavender smell
text: I personally did not like this lavender smell. Woodwick candles are always great,  they burn real slow. The wick gives that wood crackling noise. I love the candle and style of the wick being long. Its just the lavender smell that I was not too fond off. I would like it to be a little lighter in smell and really strong of lavender. Just my nose starting getting irate from it.
